lines.zh: 我贴着沙底游，离地只有一指高。
lines.en: I swim along the sand, one finger above it.

lines.zh: 暖水海洋里我最多，到哪都能碰见同族。
lines.en: I am commonest in warm seas; my kin are everywhere.

lines.zh: 我冲一下，停一下，再冲一下。
lines.en: I dart, stop, dart again.

lines.zh: 红树林的根在水下像一排柱子，我绕着走。
lines.en: Mangrove roots stand like pillars underwater; I weave among them.

lines.zh: 沙底有我的纹路，我每天都走同一条。
lines.en: My track is on the sand; I take it daily.

lines.zh: 我不游高处，高处没有可以贴的东西。
lines.en: I do not swim high; up there is nothing to cling to.

lines.zh: 我一米要停五次，这是习惯。
lines.en: I stop five times per meter; it is habit.

lines.zh: 暖流把沙推成小坡，我翻过去再翻回来。
lines.en: The current piles sand into slopes; I cross and recross.

lines.zh: 前面有条大鱼，我立刻贴住石头。
lines.en: A big fish ahead and I press flat to the stone.

lines.zh: 我身体小，转弯不用减速。
lines.en: I am small; I turn without slowing.

lines.zh: 红树林沼泽水很浅，我的背快露出来。
lines.en: The mangrove swamp is so shallow my back nearly shows.

lines.zh: 我们五条一起冲，沙被搅成一团雾。
lines.en: Five of us dart together and the sand becomes a cloud.

lines.zh: 我沿着礁石根部走，那里最安全。
lines.en: I follow the reef's base, the safest line.

lines.zh: 我走得不远，一片沙地够我过一辈子。
lines.en: I do not travel far; one patch of sand lasts a lifetime.

lines.zh: 我停在一块石头上，尾巴还在摆。
lines.en: I stop on a stone, tail still flicking.

lines.zh: 水一晃，我就往石缝里缩半格。
lines.en: The water shifts and I shrink half a block into the crack.

lines.zh: 我趴在沙上，用腹鳍把自己撑住。
lines.en: I lie on the sand, propped on my pelvic fins.

lines.zh: 沙粒在我鳃边滚过去，有点痒。
lines.en: Sand grains roll past my gills and tickle.

lines.zh: 我张着嘴对着水流，等东西自己进来。
lines.en: I hold my mouth to the current and let things come in.

lines.zh: 这里同伴很多，可我谁也不理。
lines.en: Many kin are here, and I ignore them all.

lines.zh: 红树林的根挡住阳光，我这边很阴。
lines.en: Mangrove roots block the sun; my side is shaded.

lines.zh: 我把自己埋进沙里，只剩两只眼睛。
lines.en: I bury myself in sand, leaving two eyes out.

lines.zh: 暖水海洋的沙很白，我趴上去看不见。
lines.en: Warm-sea sand is white; lying on it I almost vanish.

lines.zh: 我在数水面的光斑，数到七就乱了。
lines.en: I count light spots on the surface and lose count at seven.

lines.zh: 一会儿会有大鱼经过，我等着。
lines.en: A big fish will pass soon; I wait.

lines.zh: 我忽然弹起来一下，又落回原地。
lines.en: I pop up suddenly and settle back where I was.

lines.zh: 沼泽的水有点浑，正合我意。
lines.en: The swamp water is murky, which suits me.

lines.zh: 我贴着沙，只抬高一个指节。
lines.en: I hug the sand, rising only a knuckle's height.

lines.zh: 沙底下一只小虾在动，我懒得追。
lines.en: A shrimp stirs under the sand; I cannot be bothered.

lines.zh: 我就这样趴着，一天也能过去。
lines.en: I lie like this and a whole day can pass.

lines.zh: 你的影子落到沙上，我立刻贴平了。
lines.en: Your shadow hits the sand and I flatten at once.

lines.zh: 我抬头看你，只看到一片很大的东西。
lines.en: I look up and see one very large thing.

lines.zh: 你也太慢了，我看了三眼你才动。
lines.en: You are so slow I looked three times before you moved.

lines.zh: 我在你脚边的沙里，你大概没发现。
lines.en: I am in the sand by your feet; you likely have not noticed.

lines.zh: 别往下看太久，我会以为你要抓我。
lines.en: Do not stare down too long; I will think you mean to catch me.

lines.zh: 我只有一根手指长，你看我也看不清。
lines.en: I am one finger long; you cannot see me clearly.

lines.zh: 水桶在你手上，那个我认识。
lines.en: The bucket is in your hand; I know that thing.

lines.zh: 我退到红树林根后面，从缝里看你。
lines.en: I withdraw behind a mangrove root and watch through the gap.

lines.zh: 你一动，整片沙底都跟着震。
lines.en: When you move the whole sand bed shakes.

lines.zh: 我不跑远，我的地盘就这么大。
lines.en: I do not flee far; my territory is only this big.

lines.zh: 我被踩了一下，整条都扁进沙里。
lines.en: I was stepped on and pressed flat into the sand.

lines.zh: 我的鳍缺了一块，游起来有点歪。
lines.en: A piece of my fin is gone and I swim a little crooked.

lines.zh: 我钻进沙里，只留一个鳃在外面。
lines.en: I burrow into the sand, one gill left outside.

lines.zh: 疼让我颜色变浅，沙上就看得出了。
lines.en: Pain pales me, and on sand that shows.

lines.zh: 好在同伴多，少一条也没人注意。
lines.en: At least we are many; one less goes unnoticed.

lines.zh: 我挣扎了两下，把沙搅成一团雾。
lines.en: I thrash twice and the sand becomes a cloud.

lines.zh: 这一下我记住了你站的位置。
lines.en: Now I remember where you stood.

lines.zh: 我翻过来又翻回去，鳍都乱了。
lines.en: I flip over and back, fins all disordered.

lines.zh: 我躲进红树林根的下面。
lines.en: I hide beneath a mangrove root.

lines.zh: 我这么小，伤一次就很重。
lines.en: Being this small, one wound weighs heavily.

lines.zh: 你撒下来的碎屑落到了我头上。
lines.en: The crumbs you scatter land on my head.

lines.zh: 我不抢，我等它们沉到沙上。
lines.en: I do not compete; I wait for them to settle.

lines.zh: 这味道比我平时吃的浓多了。
lines.en: This smells far stronger than my usual fare.

lines.zh: 我冲了一次，退回来，又冲一次。
lines.en: I dart in, retreat, dart in again.

lines.zh: 同伴都围上来了，我得快一点。
lines.en: My kin are crowding in; I must be quicker.

lines.zh: 你手指动一下，我就以为还有。
lines.en: One twitch of your finger and I expect more.

lines.zh: 我不敢靠太近，可又舍不得走。
lines.en: I dare not come close, yet cannot leave.

lines.zh: 骨粉的味道混在里面，很怪。
lines.en: There is a bone-meal taste mixed in; it is strange.

lines.zh: 我吃了一粒，比看上去硬。
lines.en: I eat one and it is harder than it looked.

lines.zh: 你收手了，我还对着那片沙发愣。
lines.en: You pull your hand back and I still stare at the sand.

lines.zh: 你的靴子陷进沙里，把我挤到一边。
lines.en: Your boot sinks into the sand and shoves me aside.

lines.zh: 我撞上你的脚趾，像撞了一堵墙。
lines.en: I hit your toe like hitting a wall.

lines.zh: 五条鱼一起冲，撞得沙雾都起来了。
lines.en: Five of us charge and the collision raises sand dust.

lines.zh: 我被水流卷起来，撞在红树林根上。
lines.en: A current lifts me and slams me into a mangrove root.

lines.zh: 别用网兜扫，那玩意儿比我快。
lines.en: Do not sweep that net; it is faster than I am.

lines.zh: 我贴着你的靴子滑过，鳍被压了一下。
lines.en: I skim past your boot and my fin gets pressed.

lines.zh: 撞完我立刻钻进沙里，装作没发生。
lines.en: After the bump I dive into the sand as if nothing happened.

lines.zh: 我们这么多条，总有一条会被踩到。
lines.en: With so many of us, one always gets stepped on.

lines.zh: 你挡在礁石口，我只能从你脚边挤。
lines.en: You block the reef mouth, so I squeeze past your feet.

lines.zh: 这一下把我撞出半米，我马上游回来。
lines.en: That knocked me half a meter; I swim right back.

lines.zh: 我在沙上挖个小坑，等她过来。
lines.en: I dig a small pit in the sand and wait for her.

lines.zh: 她比我大一点，颜色也深一点。
lines.en: She is a little bigger and a little darker.

lines.zh: 求偶时我把鳍全张开，像撑起一把伞。
lines.en: In courtship I spread my fins like an umbrella.

lines.zh: 她绕了一圈，又绕一圈，才留下。
lines.en: She circles once, then again, before staying.

lines.zh: 我们在礁石底下守着一个坑。
lines.en: We guard one pit beneath the reef stone.

lines.zh: 暖水海洋里，配对只要一个合适的坑。
lines.en: In warm seas, pairing needs only a suitable pit.

lines.zh: 我赶走了两条想靠近的同族。
lines.en: I chased off two kin who came too near.

lines.zh: 她产卵的时候，我守在坑口。
lines.en: While she spawns I guard the pit's mouth.

lines.zh: 之后我们各自游开，谁也不再找谁。
lines.en: Afterward we swim apart and neither looks again.

lines.zh: 这片沙底下，很快会多出一群小鱼。
lines.en: Soon there will be a new school beneath this sand.

lines.zh: 沙上有东西，我先含进嘴里试试。
lines.en: Something lies on the sand; I take it in my mouth to test.

lines.zh: 太硬，我吐了，又换了一粒。
lines.en: Too hard; I spit it out and try another.

lines.zh: 我从不搬东西，我只会吞。
lines.en: I never carry things; I only swallow.

lines.zh: 沉到沙里的，比漂着的更容易捡。
lines.en: What sinks to the sand is easier to pick than what drifts.

lines.zh: 我把头埋进沙里，翻出一小块。
lines.en: I bury my head in the sand and turn up a small piece.

lines.zh: 同伴看见我捡，就都围过来。
lines.en: When my kin see me picking, they all crowd in.

lines.zh: 有一粒卡在鳃边，我甩了两次头。
lines.en: One grain stuck by my gills; I shook my head twice.

lines.zh: 你掉的那块太大了，我吞不下。
lines.en: What you dropped is too big to swallow.

lines.zh: 我捡到的东西，转眼就被抢走。
lines.en: Whatever I pick up is snatched away in a blink.

lines.zh: 吃完了，我就回沙里趴着。
lines.en: Done eating, I go back to lying in the sand.

lines.zh: 沙里有东西在动，很小，正好。
lines.en: Something stirs in the sand, tiny, just right.

lines.zh: 我盯上了那只小虾，它离石头太远。
lines.en: I fix on that shrimp; it strayed too far from stone.

lines.zh: 谁抢我的食，我就盯谁。
lines.en: Whoever steals my food, I fix on them.

lines.zh: 它比我小，不用想太久。
lines.en: It is smaller than me; no long thinking needed.

lines.zh: 我把身体压低，头对准那个方向。
lines.en: I lower my body and point my head that way.

lines.zh: 礁石缝里有动静，我认识那种动静。
lines.en: There is movement in the reef crack, and I know that movement.

lines.zh: 目标就在半米外，我却不急着动。
lines.en: The target is half a meter away, and I do not rush.

lines.zh: 我锁定了就不换，换目标太费力气。
lines.en: Once locked I do not switch; switching costs too much.

lines.zh: 那条虫钻出沙面，我看见了。
lines.en: The worm came out of the sand and I saw it.

lines.zh: 我这么小，只能挑更小的下手。
lines.en: Being this small, I can only pick smaller prey.

lines.zh: 我贴着沙往前挪，几乎不扬沙。
lines.en: I creep along the sand, barely raising dust.

lines.zh: 它一动我就停，让它以为沙是静的。
lines.en: It moves and I freeze, letting it think the sand is still.

lines.zh: 礁石替我挡了半边视线。
lines.en: The reef stone blocks half the view for me.

lines.zh: 我从它背后过去，那里没有水流。
lines.en: I approach from behind it, where there is no current.

lines.zh: 我数着它跳的次数，第四次是机会。
lines.en: I count its hops; the fourth is my chance.

lines.zh: 沼泽的水浑，这对我有利。
lines.en: The swamp's murk works in my favor.

lines.zh: 我贴着根须绕，一圈比一圈近。
lines.en: I circle along the roots, closer each round.

lines.zh: 它开始挖沙，土正好挡住它自己。
lines.en: It starts digging and the sand hides it from itself.

lines.zh: 再近一点，我只需要一次冲。
lines.en: A little closer and I need only one dash.

lines.zh: 我不出声，虾虎鱼从不预告。
lines.en: I make no sound; a goby never announces.

lines.zh: 我冲上去咬一口，立刻退开。
lines.en: I dash in for a bite and pull back at once.

lines.zh: 我嘴小，只能咬下一点点。
lines.en: My mouth is small; I can only take a little.

lines.zh: 它甩头，我跟着被甩出去。
lines.en: It shakes its head and I am flung off.

lines.zh: 这一口咬在关节上，最有效。
lines.en: This bite lands on a joint, where it works best.

lines.zh: 我不敢缠斗，我打一下就换地方。
lines.en: I do not grapple; I strike and change position.

lines.zh: 沙被我搅起来，正好掩护我退。
lines.en: I churn the sand and it covers my retreat.

lines.zh: 同伴也在咬，猎物根本顾不过来。
lines.en: My kin bite too, and the prey cannot cover us all.

lines.zh: 我咬完就沉到沙面，装成一块石头。
lines.en: After biting I sink to the sand and pose as a stone.

lines.zh: 你踩下来时，我也会咬你的脚踝。
lines.en: If you step down, I will bite your ankle too.

lines.zh: 我力气小，但我从不只咬一次。
lines.en: My strength is small, but I never bite just once.

lines.zh: 我从卵里出来，比沙粒大不了多少。
lines.en: I hatched barely larger than a grain of sand.

lines.zh: 暖水海洋的沙是白的，我差点找不见自己。
lines.en: The warm sea's sand is white; I nearly lost myself on it.

lines.zh: 我们一群五条，在同一块石头上长大。
lines.en: Five of us grew up on the same stone.

lines.zh: 我第一次贴住石头，就再也不怕水流。
lines.en: The first time I clung to stone I stopped fearing the current.

lines.zh: 红树林沼泽里只有三条，我们算稀少。
lines.en: Only three of us in the mangrove swamp; we are scarce here.

lines.zh: 沙底比我大太多，我花了很久才认路。
lines.en: The sand bed was so vast I took long to learn it.

lines.zh: 我出生时尾巴还是透明的。
lines.en: My tail was still transparent when I was born.

lines.zh: 大鱼游过，我贴住沙，一动不动。
lines.en: A big fish passed and I pressed to the sand, still.

lines.zh: 这片浅水养得起我们这么多条。
lines.en: These shallows can feed so many of us.

lines.zh: 我一落地就开始挖沙，那是本能。
lines.en: I began digging the moment I landed; it is instinct.

lines.zh: 水面上有火，我拼命往沙里钻。
lines.en: Fire on the surface and I dig desperately into sand.

lines.zh: 我从水面被甩下来，摔在礁石上。
lines.en: I am flung from the surface and hit the reef.

lines.zh: 我明明在水里，却突然吸不到水。
lines.en: I am in water and suddenly cannot draw it.

lines.zh: 一炸，沙底翻了个面，我被埋住。
lines.en: A blast turns the sand bed over and buries me.

lines.zh: 那根细东西穿过水，钉在我背鳍上。
lines.en: The thin thing crossed the water and pinned my dorsal fin.

lines.zh: 紫光扫过来，我的鳃一下子僵了。
lines.en: Purple light sweeps past and my gills lock.

lines.zh: 沙底翻了三遍，什么也没翻出来。
lines.en: I sift the sand three times and find nothing.

lines.zh: 雷落进浅水，我整个人被震得发麻。
lines.en: Lightning hits the shallows and numbs my whole body.

lines.zh: 沙没有了，水也没有了，只有空。
lines.en: No sand, no water, only emptiness.
